input.args: Write a new runbook in docs/runbooks/ for the trigger "no receipts / receipts stopped" (members not getting receipt emails). Source material is notes/chat-receipts.md, a chat log where Tomás diagnosed and fixed this exact incident on 2026 (the log says "September 14"): the larder-worker systemd service dies, often right after a deploy because the deploy script only restarts the web app, not the worker; jobs pile up in the procrastinate_jobs table in Postgres. Fix: check `systemctl status larder-worker`, check `psql larder -c "select status, count(*) from procrastinate_jobs group by status"` for the todo count, `sudo systemctl start larder-worker`, then re-run the count query to watch todo drain to 0 (about 40/minute). A few `failed` jobs for bounced emails are expected and not an incident. If the worker dies again right away, escalate using `journalctl -u larder-worker -n 50` and ping Tomás (or the payments/receipts owner — judge from docs/architecture.md and docs/features/payments.md who should own it, likely whoever owns larder/receipts.py / the worker). Follow the existing runbook docs/runbooks/gateway-timeouts.md as the structural example (lead, Before you begin, Steps with expected output, If it fails) and update docs/runbooks/README.md's list to add this new page. Also check docs/features/ to see if any feature page should link this runbook (e.g. a receipts feature) — only add a link if there's a real owning page per docs/README.md's rules, don't invent one. This is a second-time-it-happened incident per the chat, so the runbook must actually let a volunteer who wasn't there handle it alone.

steps.command: sed -n '1,50p' larder/orders.py larder/gateway.py larder/sessions.py 2>/dev/null | head -100; echo ---; find . -iname "*.service" -o -iname "deploy*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v .git

last_message:
Tests are unaffected (docs-only change). The new runbook, its README listing, and the architecture.md link are in place and follow the existing structure/rules.

Summary of what I did, from `notes/chat-receipts.md`:
- Added `docs/runbooks/receipts-not-sending.md`: check `larder-worker` status, count `procrastinate_jobs` by status, start the worker, watch `todo` drain (~40/min, `failed` bounces are normal), escalate to Tomás with `journalctl` output if the worker dies again immediately.
- Listed it in `docs/runbooks/README.md`.
- Added the root cause as an architecture fact in `docs/architecture.md` — the deploy script only restarts the web app, not the worker — linking to the new runbook.

No existing feature page owns "receipts" specifically, so I didn't force a link there, per the rule against inventing an owner that doesn't exist.
